sealed.statement: Under a pending unclassified source change during cold formation, the critical system-topology settling read classifies an ACTIVE node that holds a current ready lease as READY from the readiness owner's completed record, so the seed never reads itself or its ACTIVE joiners as node_ready_lease_incomplete while a node without a current ready lease, or whose row is STOPPED, DISCONNECTED or FAILED, still reads unready; five local node processes then form and admit the MovieLens schema inside the formation-only budget three consecutive times with the seed not starved.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The critical-topology read may reuse the readiness owner's completed record only under the sealed CL-012 reuse class (node-table-only token advance or nodes-only unclassified change, node row present, stored liveness current, node row serve-admissible); a lapsed lease or a STOPPED, DISCONNECTED or FAILED row must still read unready, and no read may pass allowStaleOnCacheChange: true as a blanket.
No formation, admission, lease, heartbeat or rebalancer timeout, budget or cadence changes; the fix is measured by npm run check:formation with the formation verdict reporting the seed not starved.

If any path owned by the readiness-freshness-macrotask-bound pair changes, the change boundary is the pair: its contract and witness tests stay green and the owner-interaction verification template is used.
npm run check:formation is the deterministic reproduction; a GCP run is confirmation, never the iteration loop.

claim: Falsifier probe (real SystemTableCache + real ControlPlaneReadinessService, seed + one joiner both ACTIVE with current ready leases, PUBLISHED membership naming both): getNodeReadinessSync(nodeId, {allowStaleOnCacheChange: false}) answers every dimension false (clusterMemberHealthy, controlPlaneRecoveryEligible, repairEligible, processAlive) for BOTH nodes in the apply-before-listener window of an unclassified SERVICES insert and of a nodes-only heartbeat update, and the joiner stays all-false after the listener classified the change until its owner rebuild lands. Since isCriticalNodeReady consumes exactly this read and isReadinessDimensionSatisfied requires clusterMemberHealthy true, classifyCriticalNode returns UNREADY_ACTIVE for every ACTIVE node, the seed included, whenever the barrier is closed: the node_ready_lease_incomplete reading is the deferred snapshot, not a lease fact.
rulesOut: Do not look for a lease-writing defect first; the leases are current in the probe. Do not fix by passing allowStaleOnCacheChange: true blanket-wise.
